content:
Hema Shah: Scheduling a phased deploy for schema migration feat/user_props: starting canary at 02:30 UTC, full rollout target 03:15 UTC. tagging SRE for watch.
Oliver Tran: ack — what's the canary shard % and expected rows to backfill?
Hema Shah: Canary=5% traffic, backfill ~120k rows (light writes). We'll do continuous backfill with per-shard rate cap.
Marc Li: dropping in the migration SQL snippet here — it's online-friendly but still adds an index. run order: create index concurrent -> backfill -> swap.
Marc Li: ```sql
CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF NOT EXISTS idx_user_props_key ON user_props (lower(key));
-- backfill script uses tenant chunking, rate=2000 rows/s
```
DeployBot: [deploybot] Deploy 2026.03.21-uf-322 started by Hema Shah. Canary rollout (5%) scheduled for 02:30 UTC. Playbook: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/schema-mig-uf-322
Sylvia K: put a hard pin on the API pod image to avoid accidental autoscaler picking a new build during the window. I'll publish the pinned tag.
Hema Shah: pinned to redwood/api:2026-03-21c — added to release notes.
Dan R: brief rollback criteria proposal:
- Error rate > 2% (5m sustained) on canary route OR
- DB lock/wait > 500ms p95 across >2 DB hosts OR
- Backfill lag > 2x expected (30m behind schedule)
If hit, we abort rollout, pause backfill, and restore app traffic to previous model.
Oliver Tran: +1. Add a noisy-metrics filter: ignore short blips during autoscaling spikes. Also need an escape hatch to pause backfill but keep canary traffic if write latency stable.
Hema Shah: agreed. Added: can pause backfill via jobs API: `POST /internal/jobs/uf-322/pause` — ops can trigger without full rollback.
DeployBot: [deploybot] Canary step: deploy to 3 instances (5% traffic) at 02:30:15 UTC — health checks passing.
Marc Li: sanity check: migration locks are advisory; migration path uses short-lived advisory locks per-tenant. No full-table locks.
Sylvia K: observability note — I've added a dashboard tile: user_props.backfill.rows_per_min and db.lock_wait.ms p95. Alerting: paged if backfill rows/s < 1500 for 20m AND backfill lag > 20m.
Dan R: runbook shortened version:
1) If alert fires, run `GET /internal/backfills/uf-322/status`
2) If lock_wait p95 > 500ms, `POST /internal/maintenance/safemode?reason=lock_spike` to divert writes
3) If rollback needed, `deploy rollback redwood/api:previous` and `POST /internal/backfills/uf-322/abort`
Oliver Tran: release notes link posted in the channel: https://redwood.internal/releases/2026-03-21-uf-322 (includes migration SQL, backfill plan, and monitoring links).
Hema Shah: small tweak: we'll hold at 20% for 10 minutes before 50% ramp to watch cross-shard behavior. Final gate at 80% before full.
DeployBot: [deploybot] Canary metrics update: 02:35 UTC — 0 errors, avg p95 latency +5ms, backfill rows/s ~1.9k.
Sylvia K: looks healthy. I'm standing by for the 20% ramp.
Marc Li: one more thing — retention of old index: keep for 7 days post-swap in case we need to revert quickly.
Hema Shah: team, if no objection I'll start 20% ramp at 02:45 UTC. If anyone wants to delay, flag now. :thumbsup:
Oliver Tran: :thumbsup: go for it.
Dan R: I'll watch alerts and be ready to trigger safemode.
DeployBot: [deploybot] 20% ramp started at 02:45:12 UTC. Health checks OK.
Hema Shah: thanks all — posting final checklist in the playbook and will close thread when fully rolled out.
